<function name="GetMaxSpeed" parent="Player" type="classfunc">
	<description>
Returns the player's maximum movement speed.

See also <page>Player:SetMaxSpeed</page>, <page>Player:GetWalkSpeed</page> and <page>Player:GetRunSpeed</page>.
	</description>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="number">The maximum movement speed the player can go at.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
